beats.ai: Hey! How's it going? I'm {name}, by the way.
beats.tr: Selam! Nasıl gidiyor? Bu arada ben {name}.
beats.sample: Pretty good! I'm Hakan. Nice to meet you.

beats.ai: So where are you from originally?
beats.sample: I'm from Turkey. What about you?

beats.ai: I'm from {from}! Been here {days} now. How about you — how long are you here for?
beats.tr: Ben {from}'lıyım! {days} oldu buradayım. Sen ne kadar kalacaksın?
beats.sample: About a week. {days}? Nice — what have you been up to?

beats.ai: Mostly {doing}. What have you done so far?
beats.tr: Çoğunlukla {doing}. Sen şu ana kadar ne yaptın?
beats.sample: Honestly, beaches and food mostly. It's been great.

beats.ai: Haha, that's the way to do it. Have you been to {fav} yet?
beats.tr: Haha, doğrusu da bu. {fav}'a gittin mi?
beats.sample: Not yet! I've heard good things. Is it worth it?

beats.ai: Totally worth it. So what do you do back home?
beats.tr: Kesinlikle değer. Peki memlekette ne iş yapıyorsun?
beats.sample: I run a small business. What about you?

beats.ai: Nice! I'm taking a break from work, honestly. So — craziest thing that's happened to you here?
beats.tr: Güzel! Ben açıkçası işten mola verdim. Ee — burada başına gelen en çılgın şey?

beats.ai: Haha, no way! Classic Bali. What's the plan for the rest of your trip?
beats.tr: Haha, yok artık! Klasik Bali. Gezinin kalanı için plan ne?
beats.sample: I'm thinking of doing a boat trip. And you?

beats.ai: I'm heading to {next} after this. You should come to {fav} with us tomorrow though!
beats.tr: Ben buradan sonra {next}'e geçiyorum. Ama yarın bizimle {fav}'a gelsene!
beats.sample: I'm down! What time are you guys going?

beats.ai: Around nine-ish. I'll add you on WhatsApp, yeah?
beats.tr: Dokuz gibi. Seni WhatsApp'a ekleyeyim mi?

beats.ai: Sweet. Anyway, I should get going — but see you tomorrow, yeah?
beats.tr: Süper. Neyse, benim çıkmam lazım — yarın görüşürüz, tamam mı?
beats.sample: See you tomorrow! Nice talking to you, {name}!

beats.ai: You too, mate! Have a good one!
beats.tr: Ben de memnun oldum! İyi günler!
